mods.name: Koudelka HD 3D Model Swap (Drop-In .glb)
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Optional Layer 1d .glb 3D character replacement template for Koudelka (OFF by default). Install and drop your rigged koudelka.glb into models/, then enable in Launcher or F1 -> MODS.

mods.name: Nocturne Item Glow Mod
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Adds a razor-tight, painter's-order additive shimmer and subtle rim glow directly on 3D room pickups so hidden items stand out clearly in Nemeton Monastery. Press * in-game to toggle.

mods.name: Nocturne Durability Mod
mods.author: Nocturne
mods.description: Standalone Koudelka weapon durability HUD (100% Co-op Safe): displays live current/max durability whenever you highlight a weapon in the in-game menu, plus optional equipped-weapon durability bars and low-durability warnings.
